evidence.evidence_text: Despite the rising prevalence of neural sequence models, recent empirical evidences suggest their deficiency in compositional generalization.

To address the two challenges, we first propose a novel compositional augmentation strategy dubbed Span Substitution (SpanSub) that enables multi-grained composition of substantial substructures in the whole training set.
Despite the rising prevalence of neural sequence models, recent empirical evidences suggest their deficiency in compositional generalization.

To address the two challenges, we first propose a novel compositional augmentation strategy dubbed Span Substitution (SpanSub) that enables multi-grained composition of substantial substructures in the whole training set.
